turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning, how are you feeling after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'm okay, but I have some pain in my tummy and my back is aching a bit.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: On a scale from 0 to 10, how would you rate the pain?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe around 4 or 5. It's not too bad, but I can feel it.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Have you felt nauseous or had any vomiting since the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I haven't thrown up, but I feel a little bit sick in my stomach.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Are you comfortable with your breathing? Any shortness of breath or throat discomfort from the LMA?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Breathing is fine, but my throat feels a bit sore. Like I have a slight cough.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Do you remember anything from the operating room or waking up?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Not really, I was out cold. But I do remember waking up here in the recovery area.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: You have a history of diabetes and high blood pressure. Have you noticed any dizziness, sweating, or other symptoms that might suggest low blood sugar or high blood pressure?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No dizziness or anything like that. I feel a bit tired, but that's probably normal after surgery.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Alright, we'll keep an eye on your vitals and blood sugar levels. Let the nurse know if the pain or nausea gets worse.
